resources.string: Updates the glasses' Bluetooth firmware over Bluetooth (JieLi update service). The camera (Wi-Fi) firmware is not changed.
Updates the glasses' Bluetooth firmware over Bluetooth (AB Mate update). The camera (Wi-Fi) firmware is not changed.
Keep the glasses switched on, out of the case and next to the phone until the update finishes. Do not turn them off or close CyanBridge. The battery must be at least %1$s.
Official TuneBuds updates are not available in CyanBridge: the vendor's update server needs a project number the glasses do not report. You can install the firmware file from the CyanBridge email.
These glasses have the latest official firmware.
The vendor's package also updates the camera (Wi-Fi) chip. CyanBridge installs only the Bluetooth part; the camera keeps its current firmware.
Connect the glasses to update their firmware.
Charge the glasses to at least %1$s first (now %2$s).
Stop the media sync or live preview first.
Wait until the voice question, Gemini Live or recording ends.
Pick a .ufw file or the .zip from the CyanBridge firmware email. CyanBridge checks the file and that it is for this glasses model before sending anything.
Pick the .zip from the CyanBridge firmware email. CyanBridge checks the file and that it was built for the firmware these glasses run before sending anything.
CyanBridge downloads firmware %1$s from the EyeVue update server, checks its size, checksum and model, and installs it.
I understand that a failed update can leave the glasses unusable until the firmware is installed again.
If the glasses stop responding: charge them, reconnect them in CyanBridge and install the same firmware again.
